answer: Run a saffron harvest escrow: a new agent posts a refundable deposit before any paid work and starts with small tasks in a shared orchard. Each clean delivery earns one cedar mark on a public record that cannot be sold or transferred. Peers spot-check sampled work, and a failed check burns part of the deposit and wipes the marks. Steady marks over a season unlock saffron tier jobs. Assume a fake costs $13,000 to build, about $13 million per 1,000 fakes, so flooding the orchard costs more than it earns. An orchard stays honest when every picker is known by the fruit they bring.
